```python
def transform(grid):
    # The divider is the uniform row with a color distinct from the pattern color.
    # Use the last uniform row to avoid uniform rows that may belong to the pattern.
    sep = max(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    return [[2 if v == 8 else 0 for v in row] for row in grid[sep + 1:]]
```

```python
    sep, _ = min(uniform, key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x[1]) for row in grid))
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    # Select the half with the higher density of the patterned nonzero color.
    chosen = top if sum(v == 8 for row in top for v in row) > sum(v == 8 for row in bottom for v in row) else bottom
    return [[2 if v == 8 else 0 for v in row] for row in chosen]
```
